weekOf: May 15th to May 22nd (Not live until 5am EDT on May 15th)
introMessages: This week in GTA Online rogue agent Jodi Marshall is offering 2X GTA$ and RP on all FIB Files Finales through May 21, including this week’s Priority File: The Fine Art File.

Each Finale features three Elite Challenges granting additional rewards, including a bonus for completing all three in a single run. Complete any three FIB File Finales this week to earn a GTA$100,000 bonus for completing the Weekly Challenge.
The Darnell Bros Garment Factory (30% off this week) is also doling out Doubled Garment Factory Passive Income through May 21.

Meanwhile, successfully completing The Titan Job will secure you a limited-time Merryweather Security livery for the Buckingham DH-7 Iron Mule (Helicopter). Drift Races and the returning Hunting Pack (Remix) are also delivering 2X GTA$ and RP through May 21, along with more ongoing bonuses this week across GTA Online.
